description: Prepare a private interview plan for a local job application.

# Prepare Interview Plan

Read `AGENTS.md`, local `AboutMe.md`, and `Job-Applications/[company]/job.txt`. Create or refresh `prep.md` in the same company folder. Include a requirement match, genuine gaps and mitigation, likely questions, and a preparation checklist. Do not invent facts, submit applications, or modify inputs.
